title: Inside Los Angeles' Newest Tiny Home Community
description:
Take a look inside one of Los Angeles' newest Tiny Home communities.

A new Tiny Home community has opened in Council District 2, providing 100 beds for individuals experiencing homelessness. Each 64-square-foot home accommodates two residents and includes electricity, four windows, a bed, and a locking front door for added security. 

The site also features laundry facilities, a communal dining area, and supportive services designed to help residents transition from the streets to permanent housing. Hear from City leaders, service providers, and residents about how these Tiny Home communities are creating stability, restoring dignity, and offering hope to Angelenos in need.
